data.name: 28 Leicester Square
data.detailed_description:
28 Leicester Square is a third-person puzzle horror experience set in the Victorian era. Enter a mysterious manor as a newly hired research assistant and uncover the truth behind the experiments hidden within its halls.

Explore the manor, solve escape-room-like puzzles, and piece together the story while avoiding the its photosensitive threats.

Features

  • Escape-Room Inspired Puzzles – Examine your surroundings, solve locks, and piece together clues to progress through the manor.

  • Mysterious Narrative – Discover notes and letters that reveal the truth behind the monstrous experiments.

  • Photosensitive Threats – Certain creatures are aggravated by the light, be careful where you shine your lantern.

data.short_description: Something has gone wrong at the 28 Leicester Square manor. Danger lurks around every corner. In this horror puzzle game, you will uncover the truth of what happened to this place and reveal secrets that should have stayed hidden. Every man has two sides; let's just hope you help the right one.
